title: Developer and AI SDK
summary: Stable inspect, plan, apply, validate, preview, test and optional MCP surfaces delegate the single production application runtime.
requirements: Human and JSON formats consume one operation result.
Scaffold apply requires an exact persisted dry-run plan and unchanged inputs.
Validation, test, QA and MCP delegate accepted production services.
The public Smart schema is the byte-exact owner blob, validates scaffold output directly, and inspect provenance exposes the neutral Portable Smart ABI identity for every provider.
Normal consumer build remains PHP-only and independent of optional visual and MCP tooling.
